bright_futures.summary: For 2026-27, Florida Academic Scholars (3.50 weighted GPA plus 1330 SAT or 29 ACT for 2027 graduates, 100 service hours) get 100% of tuition and applicable fees at a Florida public college or university, and Medallion Scholars (3.00 GPA plus 1190 SAT or 24 ACT) get 75%, rising to 100% while in an associate degree at a Florida College System school like Valencia. At Florida private colleges the state pays a flat rate instead: $212 per credit hour for Academic Scholars and $159 for Medallion (about $6,360 or $4,770 a year at 30 credits). It never covers housing or food, it only works at Florida schools, and you must submit the Florida Financial Aid Application by August 31, 2027.

florida-state-university.note: Main Campus Tallahassee on-campus budget based on 13 credits per term (26 per year), so tuition is $5,604 in-state or $22,232 out-of-state plus $50 fees; housing $8,420 plus food $5,740.

university-of-florida.note: Projected figures for first-time incoming freshmen based on 30 credits; UF lists housing and food as one combined living-expenses line.

university-of-south-florida.note: USF Financial Aid on-campus budget based on 28 credits (14 per semester); housing $9,638 plus food $5,770; the table is university-wide, not Tampa-specific.

new-world-school-of-the-arts.note: The BFA is still conferred by the University of Florida (the AA by Miami Dade College); a freshman pays the lower-division rate of $118.22 resident or $402.51 non-resident per credit times 30 credits, while junior and senior years run $186.08 or $1,002.90 per credit, and there is no on-campus housing.

jacksonville-university.note: Tuition $48,500 plus the $1,500 comprehensive fee; room and board is a double room ($10,660) plus the cheapest required All Access plan ($3,535 per semester), and the waivable $750 book bundle and $4,010 health insurance are left out.

palm-beach-atlantic-university.note: The latest full cost of attendance is 2025-26; PBA has posted 2026-27 tuition of $43,000 per year but no full-time general fee total yet, and housing varies by hall (2026-27 default meal plan $3,775 per semester).

florida-southern-college.note: Food and housing assumes a double in a first-year hall with the required 20-meal plan; book and lab fees are extra.

university-of-tampa.note: Tuition $34,716 plus $2,544 in mandatory student service, government and health fees; housing and food assumes a double room with 15 meals per week.

valencia-college.note: Lower-division rate of $103.06 resident or $390.96 non-resident per credit times 30 credits; Valencia's own 2026-27 aid budget uses 24 credits and shows $2,664 resident or $9,576 non-resident, and there is no on-campus housing.

university-of-central-florida.note: Main campus budget based on 28 credits; housing $8,750 plus food $6,170; the admissions page shows an older $22,482 non-resident figure, but the $891.07 per-credit rate supports $24,960.

juilliard-bfa-dance.note: Tuition only, since Juilliard lists no recurring mandatory fee; new students also pay a one-time $250 orientation fee and a $3,000 health insurance charge that U.S. students with qualifying coverage can waive.

ailey-fordham-bfa.note: Fordham Lincoln Center tuition $68,886 plus general and technology fees ($1,436); first-years add a one-time $475 orientation fee, and The Ailey School charges BFA students an annual physical therapy fee listed as $270 on one Ailey page and $280 on another.

nyu-tisch-dance.note: Tisch charges its own higher flat tuition ($37,663 per term, about $6,750 a year more than NYU's College of Arts and Science) with no separate registration fee; no dance-specific fee is listed, and the bulletin marks the figures as pending final approval.

suny-purchase-dance.note: A Florida student pays the out-of-state rate ($18,020 tuition plus $1,946 fees); first-years add a one-time $210 orientation fee, and no dance-specific fee is listed.

usc-kaufman-bfa.note: University-wide USC tuition $75,384 plus $1,952 fees; first-years add a one-time $450 new student fee, and no Kaufman-specific fee is listed.

point-park-bfa-dance.note: Conservatory of Performing Arts tuition is its own higher rate ($51,260 vs $40,260 for other schools), plus university, activity, technology and health fees ($2,280); excludes the optional $750 book bundle, and no separate conservatory program fee is listed. Room and board is a Lawrence/Thayer double plus the 19-meal plan.

northeastern-nyc-marymount-dance.note: Northeastern publishes one first-year rate for its Boston, New York City and Oakland campuses ($71,050 tuition plus $1,650 fees), so a new NYC entrant pays Northeastern pricing, not the old and much lower Marymount Manhattan rate that only pre-merger students keep; housing and food are Northeastern's general allowance, not an NYC-specific dorm rate.

boston-conservatory-contemporary.note: Boston Conservatory's own rate ($55,120 tuition plus $2,500 comprehensive fee), which is higher than Berklee College of Music's $55,620; Massachusetts requires health insurance, billed at about $2,600 to $2,800 unless waived with comparable coverage.

uncsa-dance.note: Includes the $420 dance departmental fee on top of the $3,010 general fees; in-state includes the $194 add-on for new in-state students; a Florida student pays the out-of-state rate.

calarts-dance.note: Tuition $62,954 plus $730 fees; room and board is housing $8,304 plus food $9,406; no School of Dance fee is listed, and the $2,791 student health insurance is charged unless waived.

smu-meadows-dance.note: Tuition $63,736 (12 to 18 hours) plus $8,080 general student fees; course fees, including any Meadows dance course fees, are billed separately and not included.

indiana-contemporary-dance.note: Jacobs School of Music rate: tuition plus $1,522 student service fee plus a $2,508 Jacobs program fee (IU general nonresident rate without it is $42,702); Contemporary Dance now auditions through Jacobs for 2027-28 entry, while the old College BFA in Dance is suspended.

oklahoma-dance.note: Cost-of-attendance figures (tuition $5,532 or $24,210 plus $9,971 fees); dance sits in the Fine Arts college, whose program fee is $133.75 per credit hour, and the bursar's 15-hour flat-rate math for Fine Arts comes to about $14,498 resident and $33,176 nonresident a year.

utah-contemporary-dance.note: Utah charges per credit hour, so a 15-credit nonresident first-year load is $36,368 a year on the bursar schedule; Florida is not a WUE state, but nonresidents get automatic merit awards of $3,000 to $10,000 by GPA (3.50 to 4.00), and the school says freshman housing can run $2,000 to $3,000 below this room and board figure.

western-michigan-dance.note: Computed from the posted fall 2026 flat rates (12 to 15 credits) plus the College of Fine Arts differential of $1,074.70 per semester and $70 per semester fees; a nonresident dance major pays only about 24 percent more than a Michigan resident, which works as a built-in out-of-state discount, though no separate nonresident scholarship is posted.

temple-dance.note: Boyer College of Music and Dance rate ($23,016 PA or $40,440 out of state) plus the $549 per semester University Services Fee; room and board is the financial aid office's housing $14,084 plus food $5,552.

ohio-state-dance.note: Columbus first-year figures ($14,034 plus a $30,220 nonresident surcharge); the Ohio State Tuition Guarantee locks rates by entering class, so a fall 2027 cohort will get its own new rate, and the guarantee does not cover the nonresident surcharge.

pace-commercial-dance.note: Sands School of Performing Arts tuition $62,040 (standard Pace rate is $55,040) plus NYC standard fees of $2,738, which now include books and the first-year Freshman Studies fee; the catalog calls 2026-27 rates tentative.

oklahoma-city-university-dance.note: Block tuition $30,698 plus $5,250 general university fee; OCU also lists $650 in Dance and Entertainment fees (the Applied Dance Fee is $63 per credit hour for studio classes), not included here.

elon-dance-performance-choreography.note: Tuition $50,386 plus activity and health fees $982; room and board is the cost-of-attendance figure (average first-year room $9,306 plus All Access Basic meal plan $8,229), while a first-year double alone is $8,898.

montclair-state-bfa-dance.note: Out-of-state rate applies to a Florida resident: tuition $27,924 plus $1,222 fees; room and board is the cost-of-attendance housing $10,838 plus food $6,612.

shenandoah-bfa-dance.note: Includes the Conservatory Fee of $2,090 a year ($1,045 per term) plus student service, technology and iMLearning fees; the Conservatory cost table also lists a $1,140 Applied Major Lesson Fee, charged only for registered lessons and not included.

amda-bfa-dance-theatre.note: Same rates for Los Angeles and New York and all programs (tuition $49,500 plus $300 fees); AMDA has already posted 2027-28 at the identical figures; room and board is AMDA housing $15,800 plus the cost-of-attendance food estimate $4,300 (the required LA first-year food plan bills $3,600).

rider-ba-dance.note: New-student tuition $43,580 plus $1,870 fees, excluding a one-time orientation fee; room and board is Rider's typical on-campus estimate, room type and meal plan not specified.

csulb-dance.note: Non-resident figure is CSU tuition and mandatory fees $8,748 plus $471 per unit non-resident tuition computed for 30 units ($14,130); CSULB's own cost-of-attendance table uses $12,246 non-resident tuition, which works out to 26 units.

chapman-dance.note: Tuition $69,990 plus $404 fees; room and board is the on-campus first-time freshman cost-of-attendance housing $12,818 plus food $6,082.
